methods.name: open_hw_design
methods.doc:
Description:
Open a hardware design from disk file.

Syntax:
open_hw_design([<file>], name='', no_overwrite=False, static='', cells='', sim=False, outdir='', quiet=False, verbose=False)

Returns:
Hardware design object. Returns nothing if the command fails.

Parameters:
  Name            Description
  ---------------------------
  [<file>]        Hardware design file to open
                  Default: 
  [name]          Hardware design name
                  Default: 
  [no_overwrite]  Do not unzip hardware design file
                  Default: False
  [static]        
                  Default: 
  [cells]         
                  Default: 
  [sim]           use active simulation BD.
                  Default: False
  [outdir]        Specifies the user defined path to extract xsa
                  Default: 
  [quiet]         Ignore errors during execution
                  Default: False
  [verbose]       Suspend message limits during execution
                  Default: False
